integrity: Proof and standalone verification are included. Finite computation is corroborative rather than a substitute for unrestricted statements. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Bounded-width algorithm is XP, not FPT; no closed form is established for every two-row length. The exact dyadic sequence is proved for all positive k, whereas numerical ranks to n=30 are independently finite checks. Possible differently termed prior literature remains a residual originality risk.
title: Online ranks of finite order-ideal classes: bounded-width exact computation and dyadic saturation
